span.p:
in_shift_reg reg, 8 bits
rst → 0
shift_in_en → shift in in_bit
read by SKIP, SKIP_RUN, SKIP_NORUN
in the control block (control.svg)

span.p:
acc reg, 16 bits
rst → 0
ACC_IN → {acc[14:0], acc_bit}
ACC_CRC → the same ^ (f ? poly : 0),
f = acc[15] ^ acc_bit
ACC_OUT → acc << 1
ACC_PUSH → acc >> 8
(each on acc_en)
